hints.text: 'Head', 'tail', and 'torso' and 'blended' are our indicators - woah! Three are selection indicators, telling us which letters to select from neighbouring fodder, and the other is an anagram indicator.
Our fodder is 'Cat', 'fish', 'pig', and 'mare'. We'll use these letters (or some of them) as directed by our indicator(s).

This is an &lit clue, which means that the whole clue is the wordplay and the whole clue is the definition. So, our answer will somehow mean a blend of many animals. There is such a word, and you can find it by piecing together the wordplay!
